issue_context.title: should not log "Not saving endpoints for unknown healthcheck" if the service doesn't need health check
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:

We see a lot of logs ["Not saving endpoints for unknown healthcheck"](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/v1.16.3/pkg/proxy/healthcheck/healthcheck.go#L235) when we set the log level of kube-proxy to 3. Some logs are for the service whose type is `ClusterIP`.

**What you expected to happen**:

The logs are not necessary, if the service doesn't need health check.
For example, if the service type is `ClusterIP`, then the service doesn't need health check.
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/v1.16.3/pkg/api/service/util.go#L80-L86

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:

Set the log level of kube-proxy to 3.

**Anything else we need to know?**:

Code Paths:
1. From the below codes, we know hcs.services[nsn] is nil.

    ```golang
    if hcs.services[nsn] == nil {
        glog.V(3).Infof("Not saving endpoints for unknown healthcheck %q", nsn.String())
        continue
    }
    ```

1. `serviceUpdateResult.HCServiceNodePorts` doesn't contain the service name when calling [SyncServices](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/v1.16.3/pkg/proxy/iptables/proxier.go#L1455).

1. `HealthCheckNodePort` is 0, so the service name is not added to HCServiceNodePorts. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/v1.16.3/pkg/proxy/service.go#L267

1. If the service type is not `LoadBalancer`, the property `HealthCheckNodePort` is not specified. And it doesn't need health check.

What do you think of the following ?
```
server struct should be enhanced with service type information so that the log can be refined.
```
Yes. Printing the message only once every ten minutes is less annoying than printing it every time, but it's still *wrong*. Fixing it to not print it at all would be better.

From proxier.go:
```
	serviceUpdateResult := proxy.UpdateServiceMap(proxier.serviceMap, proxier.serviceChanges)
	endpointUpdateResult := proxier.endpointsMap.Update(proxier.endpointsChanges)
```
What @bingosummer described is about serviceUpdateResult.
The unwanted log comes from the following call:
```
	if err := proxier.serviceHealthServer.SyncEndpoints(endpointUpdateResult.HCEndpointsLocalIPSize); err != nil {
```
I am weighing the complexity of adding field to data structure versus dropping the unwanted log directly.

If there is another defect around serviceHealthServer.SyncEndpoints() where additional field is needed, that would render decision making easier.
